title: Private Open-Air Pedicab Tour in Provincetown
includes: Long point shuttle ($15 per person) (not included)
requirements: Infants and small children can ride in a pram or stroller
Infants are required to sit on an adult’s lap
All areas and surfaces are wheelchair accessible
Suitable for all physical fitness levels
Up to 3 people max. We are built for mobility!
cancellation: For a full refund, cancel at least 24 hours before the scheduled departure time.
blurb:
See the best of Provincetown in a short amount of time with a knowledgeable local guide who lives here year-round. This tour combines scenic views, fascinating history, local stories, and hidden details that visitors may otherwise miss.

Enjoy a relaxed and personal introduction to Provincetown from someone who knows the community in every season—not just during the summer. Guests can ask questions, discover local favorites, and experience the unique character of the town while supporting a locally owned business.
